name: an-overridden-git-restore-of-a-keel-path-is-recorded
description: THE OVERRIDE COMPOSES, exactly as it does for the policy lock: KEEL_OVERRIDE=on carries the write, and its own gate_bypass line names this rule (`keel_restore`) apart from every other kind of suspended refusal, so a reader of the log can count destructive git commands against keel's own record surfaces on their own.
